final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT x.transreg) AS trans_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS x ON x.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = x.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(trans_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.tradekind, s1.trans_count, 1.0 * s1.trans_count / s2.total_count AS share FROM step1 AS s1 CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2 WHERE s2.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM step3) SELECT s3.tradekind, s3.trans_count, s3.share, s3.share - s4.avg_share AS difference FROM step3 AS s3 CROSS JOIN step4 AS s4 WHERE s3.share > s4.avg_share
